I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. Tobias is in that channel, so he can see it himself. The Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply is attached to that ticket.

I also passed on Hollis's warning from that thread: the import file labels the doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. Hollis wanted that fixed before anyone reimports, so no duplicate bookings get created.
